name: TooManyGames
blurb: PA's premier gaming convention at the Greater Philadelphia Expo Center, mixing retro and modern video games, tabletop and anime-dub voice-actor guests.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'TooManyGames returns June 25-27, 2027 at the Greater Philadelphia Expo Center ... WHEN June 25-27, 2027 WHERE Greater Philadelphia Expo Center, 100 Station Avenue, Oaks, PA'

notes: Batch URL toomanygames.net is now an unrelated generic browser-games site (domain squatted/repurposed) -- the real convention's official site is toomanygames.com, confirmed by an independent web search and its own content (June 25-27, 2027, Greater Philadelphia Expo Center). The only guest-roster page is explicitly titled 'TooManyGames 2026 Guests | Special Appearances', and one of its 85 names is flagged 'Fred Tatasciore - Postponed Until 2027', which only makes sense if the rest of that list is the already-past 2026 lineup -- so guests is 'none-yet' for the 2027 edition rather than picking any of those 85 (many are well-known voice actors/gaming YouTubers, e.g. Nolan North, Steve Blum, James Rolfe/AVGN, Vinny Vinesauce, but none are confirmed for 2027 yet).
